notes.title: Today's Free Recipe Is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208857/f6c2454e41cd3bb63012a92f6106065ee676a91e.png[/img]

We’re spicing things up in Pizza Hero with a brand new feature: [b]Today’s Free Recipe[/b]!

Starting now, every time you boot up the game, you’ll see a [b]new recipe featured on the main menu[/b] — totally free, no unlocks needed. It changes daily, so check back often to see what’s cooking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208857/78d11353363b50000ac37c0b140b594a5db1c89e.png[/img]

These recipes are full builds that let you [b]try out new playstyles[/b], weapon combinations, and more. It’s a great way to experiment, learn, and have fun without spending your in-game resources.

We hope it adds a little extra flavor to your sessions. Thanks for playing and supporting Pizza Hero!

notes.title: UPDATE: NEW RECIPES AND ACHIEVEMENTS
notes.content:
Pizza Hero Version 0.3.25 brings new recipes, achievements and a ton more!

UPDATES:
[list]
[*]Added 3 new pizza recipes: Ventricina Blues, Pizza Pie and Burrata Blossom.
[*]Added 7 new achievements: 3 for the new pizza recipes and 4 for rescued pets, one for each game world.
[*]Adjusted drop rate and types of prize cans for all bosses and arenas. Heavily reduced amount of dropped Golden Cans.
[*]Added new upgrade to increase Max Time Speed, this allows to increase the speed of the time up to 2.5x, the Time Speed can be chosen when starting a new game.
[*]Added button to refund all upgrades in Upgrades menu.
[*]Added more levels to most of the upgrades in Upgrades Menu.
[*]Improved upgrades descriptions in Upgrades Menu.
[*]Updated Pet Select menu, now each pet has an icon showing the game world where it can be found.
[*]Updated Save/Resume procedure so that now there are no more hiccups when switching between certain game UIs.
[*]Improved some translations in German and Italian, adjusted minor details in overall translations.
[*]Updated top tier for games played achievement to be for 500 games instead of 1000.
[*]Made various minor changes and adjustments.
[/list]

FIXES:
[list]
[*]Fixed language resetting at every game launch.
[*]Fixed a bug causing less boss enemies to spawn when resuming a game.
[*]Fixed a bug causing resumed games to be counted towards played games achievements.
[*]Fixed a bug causing issues with best wave achievements and reach wave challenges when resuming a game.
[*]Fixed level up challenges not working.
[*]Fixed Kill counter and related Daily Challenges.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed to cheat and avoid losing a life if quickly pausing the game upon defeat and save/quitting. Now when this is done the character will die right upon Resuming.
[*]Implemented various other minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: UPDATED ENDLESS MODE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208857/336b5b629418b6784443f2093d379e77c1e144ef.png[/img]

Pizza Hero version 0.3.23 improves endless mode and updated achievements.

[h3]Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated Endless mode in all game worlds to allow gamesave and to make it more challenging. Now enemy stats grow faster, swarms size gets increased over time, special swarms with resistances (to Fire, Freeze, Knockback or All) spawn at higher levels and multiple enemy bosses spawn at higher levels.
[*]Updated achievements for Endless mode, reduced waves for:[list]
[*]Dreary Woods to 25/50/75/100.
[*]Radiant Meadows to 30/60/90/120.
[*]Crystalia to 30/60/100/150.
[*]Haunting Hollows to 33/66/99/133.[/list]
[*]Updated the game and the game launcher to improved game launch procedure and added support to skip intro by pressing Space/A or Esc buttons.
[*]Implemented adjustments to improve game responsiveness upon loading/saving.
[*]Updated level up procedure to make it quicker and more reliable.
[*]Improved rewards for final boss in cemetery.
[*]Made various minor changes and adjustments.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed pushback area sometimes not spawning after a level up.
[*]Fixed a bug causing achievements target value to not update when changed.
[*]Fixed bosses not spawning in Endless mode after first waves.
[*]Fixed issue causing the sauce level to not be correctly restored upon resuming and sometimes causing a game crash.
[*]Fixed game resuming issues causing an extra level up under certain conditions.
[*]Fixed issue upon reviving causing pizza to become invincible and no level up happening.
[*]Replaced/updated/fixed a few game sounds and related scripts.
[*]Fixed Hands in Haunting Hollows not respawning in some cases. Also now they don't change color and no message is shown when spawning them in advanced levels of Endless Mode.
[*]Implemented various other minor fixes.
[/list]
Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/devseb]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Minor Updates
notes.content:
Version 0.3.18 bring a ton of requested updates to Pizza Hero.

Updates:
[list]
[*]Added home icon pointing to the starting position of paths on the map, that's a simple way to avoid getting lost on the map.
[*]Sound effects: Level up, low health and some other sound effects are now less annoying/distracting.
[*]Endless mode: now Bosses keep spawning, adjusted speed and damage of enemies.
[*]Now the character is better protected from enemies when going back into game upon level up or when reviving.
[*]Upgrades menu: improved description of stats, removed scrolling from Upgrades menu, rearranged icons/buttons and slightly increased their size.
[*]Topping selection menu now shows the Description of the selected topping (weapon) at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Added and updated some descriptions/messages in a few UIs to give more detailed/precise info.
[*]Improved the readability of topping level labels in game.
[*]Daily Challenges: updated descriptions and fonts to improve clarity and readability.
[*]Pointers used for hearts, cans, arrows and other items on screen are now more peripheral and stays on the edge of the screen instead of being positioned near the middle of the action.
[*]Various other minor changes and adjustments.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed bug causing character to sometimes become invincible and not leveling up anymore when playing in Endless mode.
[*]Fixed bug with infinite gems spawning in first game world.
[*]Fixed a small glitch causing graphics filtering to turn on and off upon level up and in some other cases.
[*]Fixed bug in topping selection menu that sometimes caused getting back to main menu after confirming a selection.
[*]Fixed issue causing enemies, pointers, paths and other game and UI items to not update their position automatically upon switching between fullscreen and windowed mode or When changing the window size in windowed mode.
[*]Various other minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update [WINDOWED MODE ADDED]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208857/77494bc2fc33aa2b8a84e3d588cd5493fea83780.png[/img]
We've just rolled out a minor update for the game: windowed mode! You can activate it from the main menu. Changelog:
[list]
[*]Game version is now 0.3.17
[*]Added option to switch between fullscreen mode and windowed mode, the option is available in main menu and in settings menu.
[*]Updated UI navigation to fix an uncommon bug happening when the UI is reloaded.
[*]Minor changes: removed Cooking mode button, updated level up cards so that the red mark is not covered by the selector, fixed typo in tutorial where instead of "Spacebar" the message said "Stacebar".
[/list]
Currently, the window initially resizes to fit mobile dimensions, but once it's in windowed mode, you can adjust it to any size. The game will automatically adapt to these changes. It's still a work in progress, but we wanted to release this feature promptly as many players have been requesting it.

notes.title: Introducing Pizza Tokens!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/2202770/browse/?filter=all][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208857/8ab0ee6ad0ea90802395f65316a305baf7c548b6.png[/img][/url]

We have just launched a new tradeable item called Pizza Tokens. These items are available for purchase and can be earned by playing the game. Here are some more details:

[list]
[*][b]Earn & Buy[/b]: purchase tokens or earn them by playing the game.
[*][b]Support Development[/b]: purchasing tokens is a way for players to actively support the ongoing development of Pizza Hero.
[*][b]Simplify Trading[/b]: Pizza Tokens establish a standardized value, streamlining the exchange of items in the marketplace. These tokens can be traded but are not sellable.
[/list]
Launch Pizza Hero and start collecting Pizza Tokens now!
